question: During the New Year sale, a company is offering a ‘Buy 9 sweaters, get 3 free’ deal to customers. What is the percentage discount offered in this deal?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Buy 9, get 3 free ⇒ total = 12 items

You pay for 9 but get 12

Discount = free items ÷ total items = 3 ÷ 12

⇒ Discount % = (3/12) × 100

**∴ Answer = 25%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Offer: Buy 9 sweaters, get 3 free

**Formula used:**

Discount % = (Free items ÷ Total items received) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total sweaters received = 9 + 3 = 12

⇒ Cost paid is for 9 sweaters

⇒ Free sweaters = 3

⇒ Discount = 3 ÷ 12

⇒ Discount % = (3/12) × 100

⇒ = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Free Item Concept

Discount = (Free items ÷ Total items received) × 100

Equivalent Discount

Buy x get y free ⇒ Discount = y ÷ (x + y)

Shortcut Formula

Discount % = [Free ÷ Total] × 100
